sections.title: Behavioral question card
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Interview: Senior Engineer, Cedarpoint. Interviewer: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate about a technical choice. Question type: conflict. A strong answer picks one story from your own bank, names the situation, your action, a measured result and one lesson.

sections.title: Language for matching a question to a story

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Điều người phỏng vấn muốn kiểm tra, ví dụ conflict hoặc ownership.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn trọng âm ở âm tiết thứ hai: com-PE-tency.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Có ý kiến khác đồng nghiệp trong một quyết định.
vocabulary.example: We disagreed about the database choice.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói disagree with + người, không nói disagree to.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Tìm ra cách để hai bên cùng chấp nhận.
vocabulary.example: We resolved it with a small test.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: re-SOLVE.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Điều thay đổi được sau hành động của bạn.
vocabulary.example: The outcome was a faster release.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói the outcome was, không nói the outcome is when kể chuyện đã qua.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Điều bạn làm khác đi từ sau câu chuyện.
vocabulary.example: My takeaway was to test before we argue.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Takeaway là một từ, không tách thành take away khi là danh từ.

expressions.phrase: This question is testing ___, so I will use my story about ___.
expressions.meaning: Nói rõ bạn chọn chuyện nào và vì sao.
expressions.example: This question is testing conflict, so I will use my story about a database choice.
alternatives: The best story I have for this is ___.

expressions.phrase: The situation was ___, and my role was ___.
expressions.meaning: Mở đầu câu chuyện bằng tình huống và vai trò.
expressions.example: The situation was a delayed release, and my role was tech lead.

expressions.phrase: What I did was ___, which led to ___.
expressions.meaning: Nối hành động với kết quả.
expressions.example: What I did was run a small test, which led to a clear decision.
alternatives: I decided to ___, and as a result ___.

expressions.example: My takeaway was to share evidence before opinions.

performanceTask.title: Tell one story from your own bank
performanceTask.scenario: The interviewer asks a behavioral question; you choose a story from your own bank and tell it in four steps.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Answer in English in about 90 seconds with one real story from your own bank: name what the question tests, the situation, your action, the result and your takeaway. Do not look at the model answer yet.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Answer in English in about 90 seconds with one real story: name what the question tests, the situation, your action, the result and your takeaway.
performanceTask.modelResponse: This question is testing conflict, so I will use my story about a database choice. The situation was a delayed release, and my role was tech lead. Two senior engineers disagreed about which database to use, and the argument slowed us down for a week. What I did was ask both of them to run a small test on our real traffic, which led to a clear decision in two days. We chose the simpler option, and the release shipped on time. I also wrote a short note that explained why we chose it, so the discussion did not repeat. My takeaway was to share evidence before opinions, because it keeps the conversation calm and keeps the team focused on the result. Since then, I use the same approach in every design review, and my teammates now bring their own data to the first meeting. That small habit has saved us many hours of debate and has made our decisions easier to explain to managers who were not in the room.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Tell the story again in English. Keep four steps and make the result more specific.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Answer a different question, such as a time you failed, with another story from your own bank.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Answer a new behavioral question with one of your stories, without looking at old notes.

rubric.label: Four steps and story choice
rubric.description: The story fits the question and follows four steps.

anchors.met: The story matches the competency and has situation, action, result, takeaway.
anchors.notMet: The story does not fit the question or steps are missing.

rubric.label: Personal action
rubric.description: The listener hears what you did, not only what the team did.

anchors.met: Uses "I" for key decisions and actions.
anchors.notMet: Uses only "we" so your part is unclear.

rubric.label: Measured result and takeaway
rubric.description: The result is concrete and the takeaway is real.

anchors.met: The result has a number or a clear change, and the takeaway is specific.
anchors.notMet: No result, or a generic lesson such as "teamwork is important".

audio.text: This question is testing failure, so I will use my story about a missed deadline.
My role was incident lead, and I had one day to restore the service.
What I did was split the work, which led to a fix before noon.
My takeaway was to practice the recovery plan before a real incident.
